technical_complexity.rationale: Contract parsing, billing logic and data integration with LLM tooling is standard engineering with hard edge cases; the founders' Deel billing background lowers execution risk.

defensibility.rationale: Custom software on customer data with ERP integrations may create some switching costs, but no moat is documented and many AI-native CRM entrants exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too recent to judge; no incumbent action against Paloma found.

market_need_then: The YC launch post frames billing, renewals and expansions as underserved post-sale work; no quantified demand evidence found. The company has since repositioned to manufacturing operations.

outcome_analysis: Paloma is a three-person YC S25 company founded by former Deel product and EOR leaders. No confirmed funding, customer or revenue data exists in public sources, so the outcome is undetermined and the record rests on the YC page and company site.
